verdict.rationale: Kick ships an MCP server and CLI that let an external AI agent query transactions, generate reports, and "automate month-end checks" (kick-docs-15, kick-docs-16, kick-docs-24, kick-docs-28), so a user could build an agent that scans the ledger before close. Reconciliation is documented as verifying "no duplicates" against bank records (kick-supp-reconciliation), and low-confidence categorizations are held for review. But there is no documented native anomaly or duplicate-flagging agent; the user must assemble the monitoring logic through MCP. missing for 10: built-in spend-anomaly detection, automated duplicate-transaction flagging by an agent, documented continuous or scheduled monitoring workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
